title: Serpent Potion Bottle
description: A single ornate glass potion bottle with a hammered metal base and cap, featuring a copper ouroboros serpent handle with a turquoise ring. The transparent vessel contains a glowing red liquid with swirling golden energy, floating petals, and small colorful fragments.
prompt: A highly detailed realistic painting of an ornate glass potion bottle centered against a dark textured background. The bottle has a hammered metal base and cap, with a copper ouroboros serpent forming the handle holding a turquoise ring. Inside the transparent vessel is a glowing vibrant red liquid with swirling golden energy trails, floating red petals and small blue and yellow fragments. Dramatic lighting with a warm glow from below, in the style of classical still life with fantasy elements.
